answer: cipher is a fixed-capacity registry: the kth raven admitted burns k inlet, one for its own slot and one to restore each resident raven whose capacity the admission decays. cipher settles each admission against the full resident set in one order and rejects batches, so a farm cannot split or parallelize the draw; n clones cost n(n+1)/2 inlet, quadratic in headcount. It breaks if inlet is refundable or cipher accepts a batch as one draw.
